notes: 'where ... grew' is the recast construct relation of עֲרֻגֹת צִמְחָהּ and goes to the rectum, headed on the lexeme-bearing 'grew' (rule 19), with the suffix taking the recast clause's subject pronoun.
The cognate infinitive absolute takes the distinct intensifier 'utterly' as its own unit (rule 56), and each written הֲ takes one of the two fronted auxiliaries (rule 17).
